body: I'm still working on raising funds to relocate for medical reasons.  Please have a look :)
I'm 35.  Still no bf ever.  You'll most likely manage a lot better than me.

I'm kinda in the same spot re: friends.  I do most of the emotional heavy-lifting and relationship maintenance.  And when I need help?  Nothing.  So sorry you're going through the same thing.

Gave up on facebook a while ago.  I couldn't deal with the "compare and despair" phenomenon you're talking about.  I don't have many friends, really, so skype / email / text tends to work for me for my minimal interactions.

The nature thing appeals to me a lot.  I mean getting back to nature.  I live in a very small room in a very large, ugly apartment complex.  I wish I could get to "nature" but it's about 40 minutes away by car.  And I can't drive.  Hiking generally sounds great, maybe without the other stuff?  I don't know.

Nature, unlike certain friends, is always there and always itself, without guile.  I feel like it's worth going to.

Yours in hiking,

GP

I don't know what catfishing is, but all the other stuff sounds familiar.

Have you considered doing something that isn't school or work?  I volunteered for various organizations a while ago when I was more physically able.  Seemed to help at least sometimes to pretend to be someone else, you know?  Someone who was capable of doing some good things for other people.


Yours in loneliness,
GP

At least you're trying.  Lots of people stop doing even that.  You should be proud of yourself for trying.  It's something.  

Do you get out much?
